title: Events alert — 2026-11-15
body:
**NVDA Q3 FY27 — Tue 17 Nov, after the close** (results ~4:20 pm ET / 22:20 Berlin; call 5:00 pm ET / 23:00 Berlin). Consensus ~$108.8–109B revenue / ~$2.47 EPS vs guidance $108B ±2% and 74% gross margin (TipRanks/companies as of Nov 15). First print with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO after Jensen Huang's Nov 12 resignation. October retail sales also land Tue 8:30 am ET / 14:30 Berlin — after a hot October CPI, a strong print would reinforce the ~85% December-hike pricing.

Sleeve read: semis (AMD, AVGO, MU, ASML, TSMC) carry the beta — NVDA sits 31.9% below its 52-week high (Nov 13 close), so either direction of guidance moves the complex. Power/utilities (CEG, VST, NEE, GEV) hinge on data-center capex language; infrastructure (Vertiv, Eaton, Arista, Celestica) on backlog commentary. With the 10Y at 5.15%, the 15% cash sleeve stays the buffer — no positioning ahead of the print.
